bullets.text: Residents in Kunnikaper in Thiruvallur protested on the streets due to a night-long power cut, and the office should monitor TNEB restoration efforts.
Motorists in Ponneri are extremely anxious as a high-level bridge across the Arani river has been damaged, requiring immediate local inspection by our team.
A 44-year-old man named Saravanan died after being run over by a truck in Madhavaram, and the office should watch police safety measures.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution near Ponneri, and the district team should coordinate with electricity officials to prevent recurrences.
CMWSSB invited bids for a DPR for a desalination plant at Minjur, and our office should track this water infrastructure development.
Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready green data center in Chennai, and our portfolio team should support this infrastructure growth.
Experts noted that AI boosts training quality for airline operators in India, and the ministry should review aviation technology adoption.
A viral post sparked debate over expensive AI tools like Claude, and our team should monitor AI tool affordability and market trends.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated residential and business complexes worth Rs 1,021 crore, and our office should review state housing projects.
